intent: Let a Teamboard member set their own profile photo, and make a bad file fail loudly instead of quietly.
approach: One endpoint, one storage write, one column swap, one control on the profile page. Validation runs before anything touches storage.
expectations: A member uploads a JPEG or PNG under 5 MB and sees it on their profile.
Anything larger, or any other type, is rejected with the reason named.
Every stored photo is a 256 by 256 square.
Nobody can change another member's photo.
context: The CSV export thumbnailer already depends on sharp 0.33.
Express 5 exposes content length before the body is buffered.
The avatars bucket already has a weekly orphan sweep.

decisions.decision: Resize on the server, not in the browser.
decisions.why: Two phones produce two different images from the same file. The server is the only place a 256 by 256 square is guaranteed.
Content length is known up front, so a 500 MB file costs nothing.
decisions.rejected: Buffer the upload first, then check its size
